assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: photographic website asset for a fictional premium coffee portfolio concept, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: editorial product photograph of a close, well-made flat white in a pale ceramic cup on a light limestone table with one small flaky croissant beside it.
Scene/backdrop: quiet grey and off-white cafe surroundings, uncluttered and softly out of focus.
Style/medium: premium honest real food photography, natural photographic detail, no illustration, no 3D rendering.
Composition/framing: landscape 4:3 image, intimate three-quarter overhead view, cup and croissant arranged naturally with breathing room around them; the whole cup visible.
Lighting/mood: morning side light, subtle believable shadows, calm and inviting.
Materials/textures: rich espresso crema and delicate microfoam latte art, tactile pale ceramic glaze, fine limestone texture, crisp buttery croissant layers.
Constraints: no people, no hands, no lettering, no text, no logos, no watermark. Produce one single photograph.
